products.name: Osteocare Glucosamine and Chondroitin
products.ingredients: Manufacturer online ingredients include calcium carbonate, glucosamine sulphate from crustaceans, magnesium hydroxide, chondroitin sulphate from fish, vitamin C, zinc, vitamin D3, ginger root extract, copper, manganese and selenium. This is a selection, not the full ingredient declaration.
products.allergens: Contains crustacean-derived glucosamine and fish-derived chondroitin. Do not use with fish or shellfish allergy. The manufacturer also notes possible nut handling at the manufacturing site.
products.directions: For adults, two or three tablets daily with the main meal, swallowed whole with water or a cold drink. Do not exceed the recommended intake; this replaces other Osteocare and Jointace supplements.
products.precautions: Food supplement, not a replacement for a balanced diet. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if diabetic, taking anticoagulants, under medical supervision, pregnant, breastfeeding or affected by food allergies. Not suitable for children. Store dry below 25°C away from children.

products.name: Wellman Prostace
products.ingredients: Manufacturer online ingredients include magnesium oxide, inositol, vitamin C, tomato extract, soya extract, L-carnitine, zinc, vitamin B12, saw palmetto, pumpkin seed extract, coenzyme Q10, iron, vitamins A, D3 and E, green tea extract, iodine and selenium. This is a selection, not the full ingredient declaration.
products.allergens: Contains soya-derived ingredients. The manufacturer also notes that the manufacturing site may handle nuts; consult the full pack allergen declaration.
products.directions: For adults, two tablets daily with the main meal, swallowed whole with water or a cold drink. Do not exceed the stated intake and do not take on an empty stomach.
products.precautions: Food supplement, not a medicine or substitute for a varied diet. Not suitable for children or those under 18. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if under medical supervision, taking medicines or affected by thyroid disease, epilepsy, haemochromatosis or food allergies. Contains green tea extract and iron; avoid taking with other green tea extract products or when fasting. Seek medical advice for urinary symptoms. Store dry below 25°C away from children.
